description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...


Support the execution of initiatives to bring back churned drivers, using data to identify opportunities and track results.
Help launch comeback incentives, communications and product initiatives for driver reactivation.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.
Manage data dashboards and analyze performance of driver strategies, to drive insights and business decisions.
Support the management of comeback incentives across Spanish Speaking LatAm, ensuring campaigns are launched correctly and on time.
Analyze campaign results and share learnings to improve future reactivation initiatives.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Currently studying Engineering, Computer science, Actuary, Economics or any related degree.
At least one year until graduation (ideally between 5th-8th Semester).
Strong Spreadsheets skills (Excel / Google Sheets) are a must. Comfortable about learning and using new software tools.
Passion for analytics and programming, with knowledge/experience in SQL (Nice to have: Python, R, Pandas, etc.).
Curious about innovation and automation, being able to leverage AI or other tools to enhance time efficiency and process automation for repetitive tasks.
Commitment and Integrity, being able to balance and manage time effectively between school and work, to ensure tasks are delivered on time.
Effective communicator. Proficiency in English & Spanish.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Develop insight-led, multi-category CX strategies for assigned markets, defining priority consumers, journey opportunities, channel and touchpoint roles, experience principles, strategic choices and measures of success.

Translate global guidelines, brand strategy, CX area office strategy and EM realities into strategic & actionable campaign and experience plans, briefs, toolkits and roadmaps across offline touchpoints, adapting global direction to each market’s commercial, channel and regulatory reality.

Lead cross-functional planning with Brand, End Markets, Digital, Trade, Insights, Legal, Finance, Procurement, agencies and suppliers; create clarity on decisions, milestones, dependencies and ownership while influencing teams that do not report directly to the role.

Challenge old ways of working constructively to transform into CX future ambition and new Wo W, by using consumer, commercial and execution evidence to identify gaps, build recommendations and balance strategic depth with business pace.

Drive initiatives end to end, from diagnosis and strategic framing through development, approval, execution support and post-implementation learning; anticipate risks, escalate early and maintain accountability and quality across strategic and business-as-usual priorities.What are we looking for?

Experience leading complex projects or workstreams across multiple stakeholders, markets or business units.

Experience leading people, project teams, agencies or cross-functional teams.

Proven ability to manage competing priorities, make decisions with incomplete information and deliver with ownership and collaboration mindset.

Strong strategic thinking and business judgment: frames ambiguous problems, identifies choices and trade-offs, and converts analysis into a clear point of view and roadmap.

Strong consumer and business acumen, with the ability to connect consumer needs, category priorities, channel roles and market realities to business outcomes.

Good stakeholder management: listens actively, adapts communication, negotiates trade-offs and challenges constructively while maintaining trust and engagement.

Advanced communication, storytelling and presentation skills in English and Spanish, with the ability to simplify complexity and enable senior-level decisionsWhat we offer you?

description:
Description

Are you a UX/UI-minded content strategist who thrives on turning complex information into simple, conversion-driven experiences? Are you energized by the challenge of helping small and medium businesses in Mexico discover the tools they need to grow? Do you want to own the digital front door for one of the fastest-growing seller marketplaces in Latin America?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, consider joining the Mexico Marketplace team as a Content and Website Manager.

What You Will Do?

This role owns the end-to-end content experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, the primary destination for prospective sellers exploring how to sell on Amazon Mexico. The mission is clear: make it effortless for potential sellers to find, understand, and act on the information they need to start their business on Amazon.

You will combine UX/UI expertise with content strategy and data analysis to continuously improve the site experience. You will track free search sources to understand how sellers discover the site, then optimize every touchpoint from first click to completed registration.

To succeed, you will need to think like a designer, write like a marketer, and measure like an analyst, all while collaborating across a diverse set of internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

UX/UI Strategy and Execution: Own the information architecture, page layouts, and user flows on vender.amazon.com.mx. Ensure every page delivers a clear value proposition, intuitive navigation, and a frictionless path toward seller registration. Conduct usability reviews, propose wireframes, and work with design resources to implement improvements.

Content Management at Scale: Plan, create, publish, and maintain site content including landing pages, educational modules, FAQs, and program explainers. Ensure content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with active seller programs and promotions.

Free Search Source Tracking: Monitor organic traffic performance across Google and AI-powered search surfaces. Identify keyword opportunities, track ranking changes, and coordinate content updates to maximize discoverability without paid spend.

Conversion Optimization: Own the visitor-to-registration funnel. Design and run A/B tests on layouts, copy, and CTAs. Analyze drop-off points, recommend improvements backed by data, and report on conversion metrics to leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with Program Managers, Product Managers, and Commercial teams. Translate business priorities, new program launches, and policy changes into user-friendly site content within rapid turnaround cycles.

Performance Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track organic traffic, conversion rates, content freshness, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights to stakeholders with clear recommendations for next steps.

What We Are Looking For

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Demonstrate

A strong UX/UI foundation: experience with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing.

A true hands-on approach to content creation and site management, comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the CMS daily.

The ability to translate complex business and program information into simple, action-oriented content that converts.

A data-driven mindset: comfort defining KPIs, running experiments, interpreting analytics, and presenting results.

Strong internal customer service focus, able to interface at all levels of the organization, from operational teams to senior leadership.

A solutions-oriented approach: comfortable identifying problems and driving appropriate fixes without waiting for direction.

Bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Enthusiasm for collaborative work and a drive to create a positive, high-performance team culture.

Success in this role requires influential partnership with Program, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure vender.amazon.com.mx delivers the best possible experience for potential sellers in Mexico. If you are passionate about using design thinking and content strategy to change the trajectory of small businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content strategy and UX/UI experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, ensuring prospective sellers in Mexico can easily discover, understand, and act on the information needed to start selling on Amazon.

Design and maintain site user flows, page layouts, and information architecture. Conduct usability reviews and implement improvements that reduce friction in the seller registration funnel.

Plan, publish, and update site content (landing pages, FAQs, educational modules) in coordination with Program, Product, and Commercial teams. Ensure all content reflects current programs and promotions within 48 to 72 hours of changes.

Track and analyze free search traffic sources. Identify organic keyword opportunities, monitor ranking performance, and optimize content for discoverability across search engines and AI-powered surfaces.

Run A/B tests on layouts, messaging, and CTAs. Measure conversion at each funnel stage, report findings to stakeholders, and implement data-backed improvements.

Partner cross-functionally to translate complex business requirements into clear, conversion-oriented site experiences. Serve as the primary point of contact for all content and UX requests related to the Mexico seller acquisition site.

Maintain performance dashboards covering organic traffic, conversion rates, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights with actionable recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing organic traffic dashboards, identifying which pages are gaining traction and where drop-offs occur. You then jump into the CMS to publish updated landing page content requested by the Program team. Mid-morning, you join a sync with Product Managers to align on an upcoming registration flow change and plan the corresponding site updates. After lunch, you review A/B test results, document findings, and share recommendations with the Commercial team. Your customer is the prospective seller in Mexico who needs a clear, frictionless path from search result to completed registration.

About The Team

The Seller Marketing Team owns the full marketing funnel for Amazon Mexico's seller ecosystem. The mission: make Amazon the first choice for every business in Mexico looking to sell online. The team attracts potential sellers, converts them into registrations, and keeps them engaged and growing. This means working across awareness, acquisition, and retention, always with a bias toward experimentation and measurable impact. The culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and seller-obsessed. Team members take ownership of outcomes end-to-end and partner across product, program, and commercial functions to deliver results

Basic Qualifications


 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Experience in A/B testing
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Axure, Keynote, and InVision
 Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields
 Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
 Experience with a variety of design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Fireworks, Visio, Axure, and Dreamweaver
 3+ years of editor, content strategist, technical writer, or content developer experience

description:
Outbound Marketing Specialist

Targeted Outreach

Stay’d

Full-time | Remote — LATAM

Department: Marketing

Schedule: Overlap with U.S. Mountain Time mornings preferred

Reports to: Marketing Director

Compensation: USD $1,700–$2,000 / month

About The Brand

Stay’d is a consortium of best-in-class short-term rental management companies building one unified brand across multiple US markets. Each brand keeps its own local identity and team, and Stay’d brings them together with shared resources like technology, marketing, finance and people. Reaching the right owners first, with the right message, is what makes that model grow.

The role

You own every outbound channel that reaches property owners before they reach us: email campaigns, direct mail, letters, postcards and multi-touch sequences. Then you push past “blast the list.” You use AI and the data in StaydOS to decide who to contact, when, with what message and through which channel.

It is a role for an outbound marketer who measures success in meetings and signed owners, not opens and sends. You build and run the engine and hand warm responses to sales; this is not a cold-calling seat. Sending a campaign is not the same as filling the pipeline. If a channel is yours, you own its cost per signed owner.

Where you sit

You sit in Marketing and report to the Marketing Director, working closely with the SDR and sales team, and with the brand teams across the collective.

title: AI Enablement Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The AI Enablement Manager helps enterprise customers turn AI from a product capability into real business outcomes. You will work with customers and internal teams to understand problems, design AI-powered solutions, deploy them in real business environments, measure performance, and continuously improve results with data and AI tools.

This is not a traditional customer success role, and it is not a narrow delivery role. You will operate more like an AI field deployment owner: close to customers, close to product, close to data, and accountable for making AI actually work in the field.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Understand real business problems. Work directly with customers to clarify workflows, pain points, success metrics, and operational challenges, then turn ambiguous needs into structured AI use cases and action plans.

• Design and deploy AI solutions. Use the WIZ.AI platform to design, configure, test, and launch AI Talkbot solutions, including flows, prompts, rules, logic, escalation paths, test cases, and performance checks.

• Use AI tools to move faster and better. Apply AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, demo preparation, conversation drafting, call data analysis, feedback summarization, issue diagnosis, and optimization ideas.

• Own the loop from launch to value. Monitor performance after go-live, identify issues, collect feedback, and improve the solution until customers see measurable value in adoption, experience, efficiency, or business outcomes.

• Work across teams to solve problems. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Support, and Customer Success teams to unblock issues and improve outcomes.

• Discover the next AI opportunity. As you learn the customer business, proactively identify where AI can create more value through optimization, new use cases, renewal, or expansion.




You may be a strong fit if you have:

• Curious about AI, enterprise software, automation, or digital transformation

• Clear communicator with customers and internal teams

• Structured problem solver

• Ownership: care about outcomes, not just tasks

• Self-driven when the path is unclear

• Fast learner, adaptable, and comfortable with ambiguity




Nice to have, but not required:

• Projects or internships in consulting, SaaS, customer success, project management, business analysis, software testing, or AI-related work

• Use of AI tools for research, analysis, coding, workflow automation, or project work

• Basics of LLMs, NLP, prompt engineering, conversation design, UX, flowcharts, or system logic

• Excel, SQL, Python, or basic data analysis




WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

This role gives you end-to-end exposure to enterprise AI adoption. You will learn how AI solutions are discovered, designed, deployed, measured, optimized, and expanded. You will work with real customers, real data, real business pressure, and real AI use cases.

• Build AI-native problem-solving habits: use AI tools to improve speed, quality, analysis, and execution.

• Develop customer-facing capability: communicate with enterprise stakeholders and turn business problems into practical solutions.

• Grow into broader paths: AI solution consulting, field deployment, customer success leadership, product operations, business operations, or AI transformation.




WHY JOIN US

Many graduate roles give you a small task in a large process. This role gives you the full loop: diagnose problems, build AI-powered solutions, launch them, measure impact, and keep improving until customers see value.

If you want to grow fast, work close to real business, and become an AI-native problem solver, this is a role where you can start building that capability from day one.




To speed up the recruitment process, you can send your CV (in English) to xuanni.teong@wiz.ai

Only selected candidates that will be contacted.

description:
Job Description

About us:

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About The Function

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

About The Role

Customer Service Analyst

Location: Mexico City

Level: 6A

Function: Supply Chain / Customer Collaboration

Reports to: Customer Fulfillment Lead

About The Role

Are you passionate about delivering an exceptional customer experience while solving complex operational challenges?

As a Customer Service Analyst, you will play a key role in connecting our customers with DIAGEO’s Supply Chain. You will manage the customer order journey end to end, helping ensure that every order is processed, delivered and resolved with speed, accuracy and a strong customer-first mindset.

This role is at the heart of our relationship with customers across Modern Trade, Wholesalers and New Business, working closely with Sales, Warehouse, Transportation, Control Tower, Finance and other cross-functional teams.

You will have the opportunity to combine customer collaboration, operational execution, data analytics and continuous improvement to directly influence our service performance and the experience we provide to our customers.

What You Will Do

Own the Customer Order Journey


Manage the order process end to end, from order entry through invoicing, delivery, rejections and returns.
Monitor customer orders and proactively identify risks that could affect service or delivery.
Coordinate the resolution of operational incidents such as expired orders, loading errors, delivery appointment issues, late arrivals and customer rejections.
Ensure accurate and timely information is provided to customers and Commercial teams throughout the order lifecycle.
Support inventory prioritization decisions when product availability is constrained.


Deliver Outstanding Customer Service


Act as a key point of contact for DIAGEO Mexico customers.
Build strong and collaborative relationships with customers and internal business partners.
Understand customer ordering, receiving, warehousing and distribution processes to anticipate issues and identify opportunities.
Negotiate and coordinate delivery appointments according to operational requirements and security considerations.
Drive timely resolution of customer inquiries and operational issues while protecting service levels.


Drive Service Performance


Support the delivery of key Customer Service KPIs including OTIF, On Time, In Full, SAMBC and Rejections & Returns.
Help drive a minimum 98.5% In Full performance, minimizing out-of-stocks, delivery failures and customer rejections.
Analyze service performance on a weekly and monthly basis and translate data into actionable insights.
Participate in customer and internal performance reviews, providing clear visibility of risks, opportunities and required actions.


Improve the Way We Work


Identify opportunities to simplify and improve order management and customer service processes.
Recommend improvements to order transmission frequency, delivery schedules, pallet configuration and Supply Chain resource utilization.
Support initiatives related to Customer Master Data, Material Master Data, Pricing Master Data and Order Entry.
Partner with Warehouse, Transportation, Control Tower and Sales teams to improve execution and eliminate recurring operational issues.
Use data and process analysis to identify root causes and support continuous improvement initiatives.


What You Will Bring

We are looking for someone who combines a customer-first mindset, strong analytical capabilities and the confidence to coordinate multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Transportation, Business Administration or a related field.
English language proficiency.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of Customer Service and Supply Chain processes.
Experience working with service and operational KPIs.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Experience with analytical tools such as Power BI, VBA Macros and/or Microsoft Access is highly valued.
Ability to analyze databases and transform information into clear actions and insights.


Experience


2–4 years of experience in Customer Service or related positions with a strong service orientation.
Experience managing customer orders and operational incidents end to end.
Experience interacting with Retail or Wholesale customers.
Familiarity with customer order portals and operational systems.
Experience working with customer expectations, issue resolution and service performance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage priorities, coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive conversations toward clear actions and outcomes.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted partner for both our customers and our internal teams.

You Will Make An Impact By


Delivering accurate and timely responses to customer requirements.
Protecting service performance and supporting reliable, on-time and in-full deliveries.
Anticipating risks before they become service failures.
Providing high-quality operational information and actionable insights.
Building strong relationships across customers, Commercial and Supply Chain teams.
Identifying opportunities to simplify processes and improve efficiency.
Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and customer excellence.


Why This Role Matters

Customer Service is much more than processing orders.

In this position, you will be part of the team that connects customer needs with DIAGEO’s Supply Chain execution. Your decisions, analysis and collaboration will directly influence product availability, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

It is an opportunity to develop a broad understanding of the end-to-end Supply Chain while building capabilities in Customer Collaboration, Order Management, Data Analytics and Continuous Improvement.

The experience gained in this role can also open future development opportunities across areas such as CPFR, Supply Chain Operations, Warehouse, Transportation and Sales.

If you enjoy solving problems, working with customers, using data to make better decisions and collaborating across teams to deliver great results, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Recruitment Scam Warning

Analyst, Technical Customer Manager - FSI

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization. You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

How You'll Find Success

You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

How You’ll Grow


Master advanced technical implementation: You will develop deep, hands-on expertise in the Qualtrics platform, evolving into a trusted technology advisor who leads medium and large-scale enterprise software implementations.
Elevate your executive influence and consulting skills: You will build strong relationships with senior customer program owners and decision-makers, honing your ability to shape strategic feedback programs and guide large, complex organizations through business transformations.
Develop commercial and portfolio leadership: By proactively monitoring account health and defining expansion strategies, you will move beyond standard project execution to directly drive portfolio performance, value realization, and account growth.
Expand your cross-functional and industry footprint: You will act as the critical bridge collaborating internally with project managers, engineering, account executive and product teams, while deepening your specialized knowledge of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management.


Things You'll Do


Portfolio Leadership: Own the success of a portfolio of customer accounts, serving as the primary technology advisor throughout the customer lifecycle
Portfolio Performance: Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities
Account Growth & Maturity: Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance
Strategic Project Management: Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution
Risk & Quality Management: Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience and maintain account health


What We're Looking For On Your Resume

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, consulting skills and a passion for helping customers transform their business through technology.


3+ years of experience: Successfully working with large, complex organisations to execute and advise on customer facing programs that deliver sustainable business outcomes 
Technical Aptitude: High interest in learning the Qualtrics platform and new technologies and deployment of technical expertise with customers at scale
Consulting & Program Management: Proven ability to plan and execute multiple concurrent projects on time and budget, with a blend of consulting and internal-customer experience. Collaborating with project managers, consultants, architects and product teams to support delivery of specific outcomes
Customer Engagement: Ability to lead workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, utilise data and metrics to communicate understanding and produce high quality customer facing documentation 
Stakeholder Influence: Ability to build relationships with senior customer program owners and decision makers
Industry Experience: Good understanding of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management in one or more specific industries. 
Entrepreneurial spirit: High tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, to understand business needs and to communicate and present to Senior Management effectively.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or business-related field.
Willingness to Travel: Able to travel up to 25% to engage with clients and teams.


Key Responsibilities

What You Should Know About This Team

Help Customers Grow


Build and maintain strong customer stakeholder relationships to deeply understand the context, ambition and strategic business goals for the customers within your portfolio
Define and execute your strategy for retaining, maturing and expanding customer accounts; including assessing customer usage and implementing new capabilities to enhance their programs
Develop success plans aligned with customer business goals and technology roadmaps
Monitor customer health, platform utilisation and adoption metrics to identify opportunities for increased value 
Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement to drive high quality customer outcomes

Provide Technical & Execution Expertise


Develop and maintain technical competence on the Qualtrics platform, ensuring a deep understanding of the leading indicators of customer adoption, ACV retention and value realisation
Utilize experience and best practices in order to understand the customer and communicate effectively how the Qualtrics platform will support the delivery of value driving outcomes and enhance their program
Lead specific project implementations for new customers to your portfolio and existing customers; including cross functional / cross team project teams consisting of Technical Services Consultants and XM Advisors, with the objective to deliver on project goals and objectives
Conduct regular risk planning, monitoring, mitigation and reporting to stakeholders both during project delivery and account lifecycle

Demonstrate Operational Rigor


Execute implementation and account management activities in accordance with global standard practices, ensuring rigorous account and project tracking and proactive risk and issue management
Ensure all project and account documentation and artefacts are developed, maintained 
Stay current with product and strategic customer journey enhancements 

Key Success Measures

For customer accounts within your portfolio over a 12 month period:

Customer Value


Net ARR 
Customer adoption and maturity of customer account
Customer satisfaction and advocacy

Successful Execution


Billable Utilization attainment
Time to Value for customers following delivery of new capabilities (measured by level of consumption 60 days following go-live milestone)
Time to Deliver new capabilities for customers in your portfolio
Rigorous scope management measured by level of Variance on Completion (VAC) of specific project deliverables

Our Team’s Favorite Perks And Benefits


Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance packages for you and your dependents.
Professional Growth & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, product training, and clear pathways for career advancement. 
Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and paid company holidays


The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

description:

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. title: Senior Technical Account Manager, Microsegmentation
skills: Being customer's main technical contact and acting as a trusted advisor for Akamai's Zero Trust solutions.
Designing a journey with customer and provide assistance to help them on achieving planned milestones.
Identifying and analyzing customer's requirements and providing technical recommendations through introduction of new features, products and services.
Assessing the deployment on a regular basis to identify gaps and provide best-practice / optimization recommendations.
Supporting integration requirements between Akamai Zero Trust solutions and other 3rd party solutions.
Providing technical training to the customer's team on the use and maintenance of the implemented Akamai products.
5+ years of experience and a Bachelor's in Computer Science or electrical engineering
Possess technical background and practical experience in cybersecurity
Build trusted relationships as the primary technical contact, ensuring customer success with Akamai Zero Trust solutions
Deliver expert advice on infrastructure design and optimization in on-premises and cloud services while developing strategies leveraging Akamai's Products
Demonstrate exceptional ability to analyze and resolve problems effectively.
Have advanced proficiency in English, with full fluency in both written and spoken communication
description:
Job Description

Are you excited by the prospect of working with innovative cloud and security solutions?

Would you like the opportunity to work in a high-impact role responsible for customer growth?

Join our Akamai Zero Trust Team!

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) goal is to ensure that our customers' organization is fully leveraging.

Partner with the best

Ensure our customer's organization is fully leveraging using our state-of-art Zero Trust solutions!

As a Technical Account Manager, you will be responsible for:


Being customer's main technical contact and acting as a trusted advisor for Akamai's Zero Trust solutions.
Designing a journey with customer and provide assistance to help them on achieving planned milestones.
Identifying and analyzing customer's requirements and providing technical recommendations through introduction of new features, products and services.
Assessing the deployment on a regular basis to identify gaps and provide best-practice / optimization recommendations.
Supporting integration requirements between Akamai Zero Trust solutions and other 3rd party solutions.
Providing technical training to the customer's team on the use and maintenance of the implemented Akamai products.


Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:


5+ years of experience and a Bachelor's in Computer Science or electrical engineering
Possess technical background and practical experience in cybersecurity
Build trusted relationships as the primary technical contact, ensuring customer success with Akamai Zero Trust solutions
Deliver expert advice on infrastructure design and optimization in on-premises and cloud services while developing strategies leveraging Akamai's Products
Demonstrate exceptional ability to analyze and resolve problems effectively.
Have advanced proficiency in English, with full fluency in both written and spoken communication


About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Analizar competidores, alternativas de solución y tendencias comerciales del sector.

Apoyar la organización de demostraciones, ferias, reuniones con asociaciones y alianzas comerciales.

Dar seguimiento comercial a clientes para identificar oportunidades de renovación, ampliación de uso o contratación de servicios adicionales, cuando corresponda.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Associate Programmatic who will:


Interact effectively with regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia) and be a strong communicator.  
Support DV360, YouTube TrueView and other DSPs campaign launches and setup according to WPP Media established guidelines. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines.  
Monitor and report on campaign checks across channels/platforms and ensure data accuracy for campaign reporting tools and WPP Media campaign management software.  
Produce daily campaign reports, including daily pacing, data inputting, and providing commentary to regional Media Activation teams. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 1.5-2 years of implementing and optimizing programmatic campaigns in DV360, The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Xandr and other DSPs. 
Advanced Excel skills.  
Strong analytical and numerical skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Our technology infuses artificial intelligence and advanced optics into manufacturing and logistics processes, helping global automation leaders eliminate defects and track parts seamlessly. We operate in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment where innovation, persistence, and teamwork drive our unmatched industry success.




Role Overview

As an Account Development Representative, you will be responsible for the localized execution of our Account-Based Marketing (ABM) outbound strategy. Operating within your assigned geographic region (e.g., Americas, EMEA, or Greater China), you will partner intensely with regional sales teams to break into high-priority enterprise accounts.

In addition to traditional high-value outbound prospecting, you will act as a modern revenue technologist. You will monitor, manage, and optimize automated digital agents executing front-line sequences, scaling our reach while maintaining brand and conversion quality.

Technical Product Expertise: Develop and maintain knowledge of Cognex machine vision systems, AI software, industrial sensors, and barcode reading solutions to effectively qualify customer applications.




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance and impact will be measured across the following core metrics:

Target Account Engagement: Number of net-new relevant contacts and qualified meetings secured within designated target ABM accounts.
New Target Account Acquisition: Success rate in penetrating and opening up previously unengaged priority target accounts.
Pipeline Contribution: Total dollar value of qualified sales pipelines generated through outbound efforts and optimized automation sequences.

Tareas Principales 

 Administración de Dynamics CRM

 

 ·       Fungir como administrador de Microsoft Dynamics CRM para Estados Unidos, Canadá y México.

·       Configurar y mantener formularios, vistas, campos, entidades, roles de seguridad, equipos y accesos de usuario.

·       Resolver con rapidez los problemas de los usuarios y dar seguimiento a los problemas recurrentes para corregirlos de raíz.

 

 Automatización de Procesos (Power Platform)

 

 ·       Diseñar y construir flujos de Power Automate que eliminen pasos manuales en cotización, captura de pedidos, asignación de prospectos, aprobaciones y seguimiento.

·       Construir aplicaciones y formularios sencillos en Power Apps cuando una pantalla resulte más rápida que una hoja de cálculo o una cadena de correos.

·       Conectar Dynamics, SharePoint, Outlook, Teams y Excel para que la información se capture una sola vez y se reutilice.

·       Monitorear los flujos en producción, corregir las fallas antes de que los usuarios las noten y mantener un registro de lo que está en operación y para qué.

·       Identificar trabajo manual en la región y proponer la automatización que lo elimine.

 

 Agentes de Copilot e Inteligencia Artificial

 

 ·       Construir y mantener agentes de Microsoft Copilot que respondan consultas rutinarias de ventas internas sobre productos, estructura de precios, tiempos de entrega y estatus de pedidos.

·       Construir agentes de servicio al cliente que redacten respuestas, obtengan información de pedidos y embarques y canalicen lo que requiere atención de una persona.

·       Construir agentes de reporteo que integren los reportes recurrentes de ventas, cartera y desempeño sin compilación manual.

·       Capacitar al equipo en Copilot y en Copilot dentro de CoWork para que usen las herramientas de forma correcta y segura.

·       Verificar la exactitud de las respuestas de los agentes antes de liberarlos y revisarlos de forma periódica.

·       Mantener el uso de los agentes dentro de las reglas de datos, seguridad y privacidad de la compañía.

 

 Implementación de Dynamics ERP (2027)

 

 ·       Actuar como el recurso técnico de Norteamérica en la implementación de Dynamics ERP.

·       Apoyar la limpieza, el mapeo y la migración de datos desde los sistemas actuales, incluido AS/400 en Houston.

·       Participar en las sesiones de diseño, documentar los requerimientos regionales y probar las configuraciones antes del arranque.

·       Desarrollar e impartir la capacitación a usuarios en español e inglés, y redactar las instrucciones de trabajo que los usuarios conservarán.

·       Brindar soporte directo durante el arranque y el periodo de estabilización posterior.

 

 Reporteo y Análisis de Datos

 

 ·       Construir y mantener reportes de ventas, oportunidades, cartera y actividad en Dynamics, Excel y Power BI.

·       Automatizar los reportes recurrentes para que lleguen a tiempo sin que nadie los arme.

·       Analizar la información de ventas y clientes y señalar lo que los números muestran, no únicamente lo que dicen.

·       Apoyar con datos confiables los ejercicios de presupuesto, pronóstico y revisión de desempeño de la región.

·       Coordinar con el equipo de Power BI en Francia los requerimientos de tableros regionales.

 

 Calidad y Gobierno de Datos

 

 ·       Ser responsable de la calidad de los datos de clientes, contactos, oportunidades y cuentas en el CRM.

·       Construir validaciones, campos obligatorios y controles de duplicados que impidan la entrada de datos incorrectos.

·       Realizar auditorías periódicas de asignación de cuentas, territorios e integridad de los registros.

·       Mantener los estándares de nomenclatura y la documentación para que los datos sigan siendo útiles conforme crezca el equipo.

 

 Capacitación, Adopción y Soporte a Usuarios

 

 ·       Capacitar a usuarios nuevos y actuales en Dynamics CRM, Power Automate y Copilot, en español e inglés.

·       Elaborar y mantener instrucciones de trabajo breves y guías rápidas de las herramientas que usa el equipo.

·       Sostener sesiones de trabajo periódicas con ventas, ventas internas y servicio al cliente para recoger lo que no está funcionando.

·       Dar seguimiento a la adopción y el uso, y acercarse directamente a los usuarios que necesiten apoyo.

·       Explicar temas técnicos en lenguaje sencillo a personas que no son técnicas.

description:
HIRING: Email Account Manager (Remote, Latin America)




- $2,500 USD per month, full-time

- Fully remote from Latin America, working at least 5 hours a day inside 9 AM to 5 PM US Central

- Working with 7 & 8 figure DTC brands




If you're hungry to become one of the best email marketers in ecommerce, then this post is for you…




FluenceFlow is an email marketing agency for DTC brands doing $1M+ a year, and we're looking for an Account Manager to join our team.




You'll take full ownership of your accounts. Our designers design and our Klaviyo tech builds, so your time goes into strategy, copy and results.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:




- Running multiple client accounts end to end: strategy, calendar, offers, copy, approvals and results. You're the client's main contact in their Slack channel.

- Planning each client's monthly calendar, and pitching the sales, promotions and campaign ideas that go on it

- Getting the offer facts first (code, dates, sale page, products), then writing campaign and flow copy

- Moving every email from idea to scheduled: copy, Figma design by our designers, internal review, client approval, Klaviyo build by our tech. You chase approvals early.

- Final QA before anything is scheduled: links and UTMs, segment, send time, subject and preview, offer and code matching the popup and site, prices, footer. Nothing goes live without client approval.

- Running A/B tests (subject lines, popup offers), watching deliverability, and reading Klaviyo results to find the best send times and angles




CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS:




- Clear, confident English, written and spoken

- Experience writing ecommerce email copy and managing more than one Klaviyo account at once

- Strong Klaviyo knowledge (flows, segments, triggers, filters, timing). You don't build every email, but you know how it should be built, so you can tell the tech exactly what to build and spot a wrong trigger, filter or delay when you review it.

- You know your numbers (email's share of revenue, revenue per recipient, flow revenue)

- You know which promotions and offers work for DTC brands, and you can come up with strong campaign ideas on your own




NICE TO HAVE:




- Email marketing agency experience




WHY WORK WITH US?




- Work from anywhere with flexible working hours

- Work with 7 & 8 figure DTC brands

- A team of designers and a Klaviyo tech behind you

- Potential for progression into leadership roles

- A team that cares about overdelivering, making our clients real profit, always getting better, and enjoying the work

That is the whole job.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

Content Creation

Follow content briefs and editorial guidelines to optimize for visibility and conversion.

Collaborate with SEO specialists and Content Managers to adjust existing content when needed.

Cooperate with other writers to maintain consistent quality and tone across projects.

Participate in content reviews and workshops to improve writing quality and efficiency.

Communicate proactively about challenges, progress, and content ideas.

Native or near-native Spanish speaker with strong cultural and market knowledge of Mexico

Solid experience writing SEO-driven content.

Practical knowledge of CMS platforms (e.g. WordPress).

Comfortable working in a remote, multicultural environment.

Work on high-traffic international brands reaching millions of sports fans worldwide.

Join a diverse, international team passionate about sports, content, and digital innovation.

Opportunities to grow within a fast-expanding global media company.

A culture of autonomy, trust, and collaboration.

Competitive Compensation Depending On Experience And Seniority.

If you’re passionate about sports, content, and iGaming and you want to make an impact in one of Latin America’s key markets we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape North Star Network’s content strategy across Latin America.

About PayJoy




 




PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.




 




This role




As Director of Product Management, Onboarding, you will lead a team of four product managers responsible for one of the most critical parts of PayJoy's business: the journey that brings customers to originate a loan.




You will own the vision for the end-to-end onboarding experience across both digital and in-store channels, with digital as an increasingly important focus for the team. As PayJoy expands, you will play a key role in launching new countries, guiding the strategic decisions of where to build global, scalable solutions versus where to localize for specific markets.




Your teams will span:







Application — Optimizing for a fast, transparent digital application that adheres to local regulation in every market we serve.








Direct-to-Consumer — Building fully digital acquisition journeys that don't begin in a physical store, a fast-growing channel for PayJoy.








Enterprise — Building digital solutions that empower our partners to onboard more customers with PayJoy, turning those relationships into a powerful engine for growth.








Offers/Risk — Refining how offers are presented and bringing in new data sources that let us underwrite customers who are newer to credit or have thinner credit histories.










ResponsibilitiesVision & strategy






Define and drive the multi-year product strategy for PayJoy's onboarding experience.








Capitalize on incoming customer demand by designing personalized, high-converting onboarding journeys across digital and in-store channels.








Set the strategy for launching onboarding in new countries as PayJoy expands — deciding where to build global, scalable solutions versus where to localize for specific markets.








Identify opportunities to extend onboarding beyond loan origination — including pre-qualification, cross-sell at the point of application, and reactivation of returning customers.







Team leadership & delivery






Lead, coach, and grow a team of four product managers, setting a high quality bar and empowering them to own end-to-end delivery across their surfaces — from discovery and prioritization through launch and iteration.








Set the direction and standards for application flow, data architecture, performance, and UX consistency across digital and in-store channels, and hold the team accountable to them.








Establish the operating rhythm and prioritization framework your team uses to make sharp trade-offs and ship with both quality and speed.








Ensure onboarding launches in new markets land quickly and compliantly, guiding the team's build-global-versus-localize decisions and holding the bar on regulatory requirements in every market.







Cross-functional leadership






Partner deeply with Engineering leadership to align on architecture decisions, build out onboarding best practices, and scale onboarding capacity.








Own key business KPIs such as conversion rate through the onboarding funnel and cost per approved customer.








Ensure onboarding investments accelerate core revenue to the business.








Influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations to align on priorities and trade-offs.










Qualifications









8+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or staff-level role.








Demonstrated experience building and scaling consumer products — ideally at a company that's gone through a period of rapid growth or a platform inflection point.








Deep expertise across the customer journey: acquisition and onboarding funnels, conversion optimization, and the data infrastructure that supports them.








Strong background in fintech or consumer financial services preferred








Proven ability to translate ambiguous strategic goals into clear roadmaps, sharp prioritization decisions, and measurable outcomes.








Ability to drive the analytical measurement of the team — ensuring the right instrumentation is in place to build dashboards, track performance, and continuously monitor the health of the product.








Experience leading and inspiring product teams, managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders at significant scale.








Exceptional cross-functional influencer across engineering, design, data, risk, and operations — without relying on formal authority.








Fluency in English, written and spoken.









 




Nice to have








Experience with platform-level product architecture — particularly secured/unsecured or credit lifecycle product models.








Background in emerging markets, LATAM, or building products for underbanked consumer segments.








Hands-on experience with conversion optimization, growth loops, or customer data platforms and communication tooling.

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar



Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina. Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal, reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones.

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

description:
The Lead, AI Business Enablement guides the artificial intelligence journey of Newell's LATAM eCommerce business. It is a senior individual contributor role for a curious builder: someone who turns AI capability into commercial results across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers, and who helps the whole regional organization work smarter along the way.

You'll have real freedom to explore, prototype and test ideas — and the backing to scale the ones that succeed. Some experiments won't work, and that's part of the deal. What matters is learning fast, being honest about results and turning the wins into everyday practice across the region.




Where You'll Make an Impact

Your energy will center on three missions.

Mission 1 | Drive Commercial Growth

Build the insight-to-action engine that accelerates revenue and profitability across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers.

What you'll do

Shape the commercial analytics agenda for the region: sales, market share, pricing, digital shelf, assortment, search performance, retail media, traffic, conversion, availability, Buy Box and profitability.
Turn ambiguous business questions into quantified opportunities, business cases and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with Sales, Category Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Digital to help decisions move from weeks to days.
Bring data to commercial priorities and help teams learn from what the numbers say.

Success looks like

Commercial decisions become faster, better informed and easier to trace to outcomes, with revenue and margin wins the team can celebrate together.

Mission 2 | Evolve Ways of Working

Champion continuous improvement across the LATAM eCommerce organization: simpler processes, less manual work and good ideas that travel across markets.

What you'll do

Explore and rethink core commercial processes together with the teams that run them.
Reduce manual work through automation and help the best practices spread across markets.
Guide cross-functional improvement initiatives from diagnosis to adoption, with empathy for how people experience change.
Create playbooks and documentation that help improvements stick.

Success looks like

A more productive organization: hours returned to commercial teams, fewer handoffs and ways of working that scale naturally across countries.

Mission 3 | Explore, Test and Scale AI

Take AI from ideas to everyday practice through experimentation: try, test, learn and scale what works.

What you'll do

Spot and prioritize promising AI use cases across the business, guided by a clear view of potential value.
Prototype, pilot and scale solutions such as commercial copilots, AI agents, workflow automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, content generation, reporting automation and knowledge assistants.
Care for quality along the way: evaluation, reliability, responsible AI practices and data privacy, including LGPD.
Nurture adoption through enablement, training and honest measurement of real usage.
Stay curious about the frontier and test emerging AI technologies.

Success looks like

AI woven into everyday operations, with adoption and impact everyone can see: less manual work, faster execution and a growing competitive edge.

How You'll Operate

As a P3 in Newell's Job Architecture, you'll work with a high degree of autonomy under broad direction.

Shape: the LATAM eCommerce AI enablement roadmap, solution design and prioritization, and regional best practices.
Influence: cross-functional, multi-country initiatives, partnering with stakeholders up to Director level.
Develop others: mentor analysts across the region and help grow the organization's AI fluency.
Recommend: bring investment ideas, vendor options and trade-offs to eCommerce leadership with a clear point of view.

Your First Year: Explore, Experiment, Scale

A natural arc for the first 12 months, which we'll shape together.

Explore — first 90 days: immerse in the business, listen to teams across markets, map workflows and identify the opportunities with the most potential.
Experiment — by month six: launch the first pilots in one or two markets, test and learn, and measure openly what works and what doesn't.
Scale — by month 12: turn the successful experiments into solutions adopted across the region, and share the learning openly, including from the pilots that didn't make it.

What You'll Bring




Experience And Skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.
Around seven years or more of experience across eCommerce, commercial analytics, digital transformation or AI solutions, including meaningful hands-on time designing, testing and deploying AI or automation solutions that made it into everyday use.
Stories of things you've built: solutions people actually adopted, the results they produced and the experiments that taught you the most.
Strong marketplace fluency: the economics of Amazon and Mercado Libre, including retail media, digital shelf, search, Buy Box dynamics, 1P/3P models and profitability drivers.
Hands-on comfort with SQL and Python, plus working command of LLM APIs and frameworks (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation), enterprise automation (Power Platform, n8n, Make) and advanced Power BI.
Confident, clear communication with senior stakeholders, in writing and in the room.

Languages

Spanish: native or full professional proficiency.
English: full professional proficiency. English is the working language with regional and global leadership, and parts of the selection process are conducted in English.

Nice to have

Consumer goods, retail or marketplace industry experience at scale.
Experience with AI governance, model evaluation and data privacy in enterprise environments.
Internal copilots or agents you've built that found sustained adoption.
Lean Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement certification.
Experience scaling solutions across multi-country organizations.

Equinox Gold es una compañía productora de oro enfocada en el crecimiento, con sede corporativa en Vancouver, Columbia Británica. Opera un portafolio diversificado de minas de alta calidad y larga vida útil en Canadá, Estados Unidos, México y Nicaragua. Guiados por nuestros valores fundamentales de integridad, excelencia, responsabilidad y trabajo en equipo, fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo seguro, incluyente y gratificante, donde un equipo talentoso y experimentado trabaja en conjunto para ofrecer operaciones confiables, minería responsable y valor a largo plazo para nuestros accionistas y las comunidades donde operamos.

Camino Rojo, se ubica en Zacatecas, México, con producción comercial desde 2022. Gracias a su cercanía con infraestructura vial y eléctrica, la operación cuenta con condiciones logísticas favorables, lo que la posiciona como un sitio clave dentro de nuestro portafolio. Su proceso productivo combina trituración de mineral y lixiviación en pilas (heap leaching), con una capacidad de trituración de aproximadamente 19,200 toneladas por día. Se espera que en 2026 produzca entre 110,000 y 120,000 onzas de oro.

description:
About Us

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.

How We Work


Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate. 
Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels. 
Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint. 


The Role

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

Part of that commitment is to engage with a wider ecosystem of early adopters, researchers and developers, and make sure we engage deeply with our mission of building progress at the edge of what is possible.

You authentically care about our mission of empowering builders globally to have more control over AI. Your core strength is bringing people together. You craft and organize experiences that allow users to connect with Adaption, our team, and with each other.

What You'll Do


Establish our overall strategy for supporting developers, researchers and enterprises who want to have more control over their AI. 
Build and maintain Adaption's developer community spaces (Discord server, forums) from the ground up, answer questions, capture feedback, and turn it into actionable issues for the team
Develop, manage, and run Adaption's ambassador program, from recruiting and onboarding ambassadors to equipping them with the resources, recognition, and support to represent Adaption in their own communities. 
Organize and lead meetups, hackathons, office hours, and live streams that introduce Adaption to new developer audiences
Collaborate with developer groups, universities, accelerators, and open-source communities to co-host and amplify high-quality events
Spotlight user projects and design partners (case studies, writeups, guest talks). 
Build automations and systems that make community operations scale - when you do something twice, you figure out how to do it better the third time
Work closely with technical and marketing teams on cross-functional projects and feedback loops
Stay connected with community members over time, keeping a mental map of who's doing interesting work, who should meet who, and what people are building


Skills You'll Bring

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:


2–3 years in a community lead role or start up ops role, with a track record of engaging technical users

Genuine empathy for developers and curiosity about what they're building - you care about individuals, and about changing the status quo of who can shape AI. Energized by people - social situations charge you up, you're the first to say hello, and you follow up


Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box.
